questions: What is your favorite way to unwind after work? Share a story about how it made you feel relaxed.
Describe a time when someone surprised you with a joke at lunchtime. How did it affect your mood?
How do you typically handle disagreements with friends or colleagues? Did it involve laughter?
Can you tell us a funny anecdote from your childhood or youth that still makes you smile now?
Why do you think it’s important to have fun in our lives sometimes? Give an example of something you recently did to bring joy to someone else.
Have you ever told a joke that made someone cry? Describe the impact it had on both of you.
Do you prefer listening to jokes versus learning new facts? What was your most memorable experience where humor stood out as impactful?
How does humor help you cope with stress or challenging times? Have there been instances where humor helped resolve conflicts?
In what ways can we improve our chances of laughing together as a team? Share a strategy you've used before.
If you could give one piece of advice to boost everyone's sense of humor, what would it be?
What kind of humor do you enjoy the most – lighthearted banter, clever wordplay, or heartfelt moments?
Has humor played a role in resolving misunderstandings or improving relationships in your past experiences?
What do you think is the difference between comedy and humor, and how do they manifest differently in social settings?
Have you ever witnessed another person experiencing a moment of pure happiness due to humor? How did it affect them?
When was the last time you found humor in a mundane situation? How did it make you appreciate the world around you?
Is there anything you’re looking forward to this weekend that involves some form of entertainment or playfulness?
Have you noticed a correlation between good humor and better health outcomes? Explain why you think so.
If you could invent a tool to enhance humor appreciation among non-humor-loving individuals, what feature would it have?
How has humor shaped your understanding of the world? Can you provide an example of a concept you’ve learned because of humor?
In what ways do you believe humor contributes to mental well-being? Are there particular types of humor that promote this benefit?
